question: How is the height of the ābhāsa building divided according to this teaching?
premises: The context is the ābhāsa building.
The height is the dimension under discussion.
The height is described as fivefold.
inference: In the ābhāsa building, the height is divided into five parts.
plain_english: O twice-born one, in the ābhāsa building the height is divided into five parts.
